extension.description: Classic ASP language support backed by asp-lsp.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.title: Get Started with Classic ASP LSP
walkthrough.gettingStarted.description: Open Classic ASP files, read diagnostics, and learn editor helpers such as inlay hints and CodeLens.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.openClassicAs: Learn which files activate the extension and where VS Code shows language features.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.readEditorSig: Use suggestions, hover, diagnostics, and navigation without needing to know every VS Code command first.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.understandHin: Learn why small labels appear inside code and why clickable links appear above procedures and classes.
walkthrough.gettingStarted.useProjectVie: Preview the analyzed file set and open graph or flowchart views when you need a wider picture.
configuration.title: Classic ASP LSP
configuration.locale.description: Display language for asp-lsp generated diagnostics, code actions, CodeLens, and extension messages. Auto follows the VS Code or LSP client locale.
configuration.defaultLanguage.descriptio: Default server-side script language for Classic ASP pages.
configuration.checkJs.description: Enable semantic checking for client JavaScript regions.
configuration.incremental.mode.descripti: Controls parser incremental update strategy. full enables range rescans with CST node reuse, legacy keeps the conservative fallback path, and off reparses the full document after text changes.
configuration.incremental.analysis.descr: Enable incremental VBScript analysis memoization for reused CST nodes. Disable this to force per-analysis statement snapshots while keeping parser incremental mode unchanged.
configuration.diagnostics.debounceMs.des: Delay, in milliseconds, before publishing diagnostics after text changes. Set to 0 to publish immediately.
configuration.debug.output.description: Controls asp-lsp debug timing logs in the VS Code Output channel. Off disables logs, summary logs operation start and completion, and verbose adds per-step timings.
configuration.debug.logFile.enabled.desc: Write asp-lsp debug and trace logs to a rotating log file. Disabled by default.
configuration.debug.logFile.path.descrip: Path for the asp-lsp debug log file. Leave empty to use the extension storage default path.
configuration.javascript.unusedDiagnosti: Report unused JavaScript and JScript locals and parameters as hint diagnostics.
configuration.javascript.autoImports.des: Enable TypeScript-powered JavaScript and JScript auto import completions and quick fixes.
configuration.javascript.ignoreProjectCo: Ignore nearest tsconfig.json or jsconfig.json when building embedded JavaScript and JScript language service projects.
configuration.javascript.compilerOptions: Additional TypeScript compiler options applied to embedded JavaScript and JScript language service projects after tsconfig.json or jsconfig.json is read. asp-lsp still forces browser-safe options such as allowJs, noEmit, and checkJs.
configuration.virtualRoot.description: Root directory used to resolve virtual include paths.
configuration.virtualRoots.description: Additional root directories used to resolve virtual include paths.
configuration.windowsPathResolution.desc: Resolve Classic ASP include paths case-insensitively like Windows and report diagnostics when include path casing differs from the file system. Disable to use the host file system behavior only.
configuration.legacyEncoding.description: Encoding used when reading unopened include files. Auto detection is used by default.
configuration.format.indentSize.descript: Base indentation width for Classic ASP formatting. Leave unset to use VS Code editor tabSize unless a language-specific indent size overrides it.
configuration.format.indentStyle.descrip: Base indentation style for Classic ASP formatting. Choose space or tab; leave unset to follow VS Code editor insertSpaces unless a language-specific indent style overrides it.
configuration.format.printWidth.descript: Shared preferred wrap width for embedded HTML and CSS. Set a positive number to request wrapping near that width; set 0 or leave unset to let each embedded formatter use its own default.
configuration.format.endOfLine.descripti: Line ending written by full-document formatting. Use lf or crlf to force one style; auto keeps the document's existing LF or CRLF style.
Add one final line break when full-document formatting produces edits. Disabling this does not remove an existing final line break.
configuration.format.preserveNewLines.de: Keep existing blank lines while embedded HTML and CSS are formatted. Disable only when the formatter should collapse manually inserted vertical spacing.
configuration.format.maxPreserveNewLines: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines kept in embedded HTML and CSS when blank-line preservation is enabled. Leave unset for the embedded formatter default; use 0 to remove extra blank lines.
configuration.format.indentEmptyLines.de: Indent otherwise empty lines inside embedded HTML and CSS blocks. This can keep legacy layout visually aligned, but may create whitespace-only lines.
configuration.format.enabledLanguages.de: Languages the formatter may rewrite in Classic ASP files: html, vbscript, css, javascript, and jscript. Remove a language to leave those regions untouched while other enabled languages still format.
configuration.format.embeddedLanguageFor: Controls the embedded CSS and JavaScript/JScript formatting pass. auto formats those regions when enabled; off leaves them unchanged while HTML and ASP/VBScript formatting can still run.
configuration.format.respectDisableRegio: Honor `asp-format off` / `asp-format on` and `asp-lsp-format off` / `asp-lsp-format on` markers. Text inside disabled ranges is restored after formatting so fragile legacy code is not rewritten.
configuration.format.htmlIndentSize.desc: Indent width used by embedded HTML formatting. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentSize, then VS Code editor tabSize.
configuration.format.htmlIndentStyle.des: Indent style used by embedded HTML formatting. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentStyle, then VS Code editor insertSpaces.
Maximum line length requested from the embedded HTML formatter. Leave unset to use aspLsp.format.printWidth; set 0 to disable HTML wrapping requests.
Attribute wrapping strategy passed to the embedded HTML formatter. auto uses the service default, preserve modes keep existing attribute breaks, force modes split attributes more aggressively, and aligned modes line up wrapped attributes.
configuration.format.htmlWrapAttributesI: Indent width used when the HTML formatter aligns wrapped attributes. Leave unset to use the normal HTML indentation width.
configuration.format.htmlIndentInnerHtml: Indent children of top-level html, head, and body elements when the file is formatted as a complete HTML document. Keep disabled for Classic ASP include fragments that are not full documents.
configuration.format.htmlUnformatted.des: Comma-separated HTML tag names whose start and end tags should not be reformatted. Use this for whitespace-sensitive, generated, or server-controlled markup.
configuration.format.htmlContentUnformat: Comma-separated HTML tag names whose inner content should not be reformatted. Use this for tags that contain preformatted text, generated fragments, or mixed server output.
configuration.format.htmlExtraLiners.des: Comma-separated HTML tag names that should receive an extra blank line before them during HTML formatting. Useful for separating large block-level sections in full pages.
configuration.format.cssIndentSize.descr: Indent width used by embedded CSS formatting. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentSize, then VS Code editor tabSize.
configuration.format.cssIndentStyle.desc: Indent style used by embedded CSS formatting. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentStyle, then VS Code editor insertSpaces.
configuration.format.cssWrapLineLength.d: Maximum line length requested from the embedded CSS formatter. Leave unset to use aspLsp.format.printWidth; set 0 to disable CSS wrapping requests.
configuration.format.cssNewlineBetweenRu: Insert a blank line between CSS rulesets when formatting style blocks and style attributes. Disable for denser legacy stylesheets.
configuration.format.cssNewlineBetweenSe: Place each selector in a comma-separated CSS selector list on its own line. Disable to keep selector lists compact.
configuration.format.cssSpaceAroundSelec: Insert spaces around CSS selector combinators such as `>`, `+`, and `~`. Enable when project style prefers `.a > .b` over `.a>.b`.
configuration.format.cssBraceStyle.descr: Brace style used by embedded CSS formatting. collapse keeps opening braces on the selector line; expand moves opening braces to a separate Allman-style line.
configuration.format.javascriptIndentSiz: Indent width used by embedded JavaScript formatting. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentSize, then VS Code editor tabSize.
configuration.format.javascriptIndentSty: Indent style used by embedded JavaScript formatting. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentStyle, then VS Code editor insertSpaces.
configuration.format.jscriptIndentSize.d: Indent width used by server-side or client-side JScript formatting. Leave unset to fall back to JavaScript indent size, aspLsp.format.indentSize, then VS Code editor tabSize.
Indent style used by server-side or client-side JScript formatting. Leave unset to fall back to JavaScript indent style, aspLsp.format.indentStyle, then VS Code editor insertSpaces.
configuration.format.javascriptSemicolon: Semicolon preference passed to the TypeScript formatter for embedded JavaScript/JScript. ignore preserves formatter judgment, insert adds missing semicolons, remove removes optional semicolons, and null uses the TypeScript default.
configuration.format.javascriptIndentSwi: Controls whether JavaScript/JScript `case` clauses are indented inside `switch` blocks. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
configuration.format.javascriptPlaceOpen: Controls whether JavaScript/JScript function opening braces move to a new line. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls whether JavaScript/JScript control-block opening braces move to a new line. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
configuration.format.javascriptInsertSpa: Controls spaces after commas in embedded JavaScript/JScript lists and arguments. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls spaces after semicolons in JavaScript/JScript `for` statement headers. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls spaces around JavaScript/JScript binary operators such as `+`, `=`, and `===`. Enabled by default to match existing Classic ASP LSP formatting behavior.
Controls spaces after JavaScript/JScript control-flow keywords such as `if`, `for`, and `while`. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls the space after the `function` keyword in anonymous JavaScript/JScript functions. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls spaces just inside non-empty JavaScript/JScript parentheses, for example `( value )`. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls spaces just inside non-empty JavaScript/JScript brackets, for example `[ value ]`. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls spaces just inside non-empty JavaScript/JScript braces, for example `{ value }`. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls spaces inside empty JavaScript/JScript braces. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Controls the space before parentheses in JavaScript/JScript function declarations and expressions. Leave unset to use the TypeScript formatter default.
Indent width used by VBScript formatting inside ASP regions. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentSize, then VS Code editor tabSize.
configuration.format.vbscriptIndentStyle: Indent style used by VBScript formatting inside ASP regions. Leave unset to fall back to aspLsp.format.indentStyle, then VS Code editor insertSpaces.
configuration.format.vbscriptKeywordCase: Keyword casing used by VBScript formatting. preserve keeps existing keyword spelling, upper/lower/title rewrite keywords, and null keeps the legacy aspLsp.format.uppercaseKeywords behavior.
configuration.format.vbscriptLineContinu: Extra indentation width for VBScript continuation lines ending with `_`. Leave unset to indent continued lines by one VBScript indent unit.
configuration.format.vbscriptSelectCaseI: Controls how VBScript `Case` lines are indented. caseIndented nests Case under Select Case; caseAligned keeps Case aligned with the Select Case line.
configuration.format.uppercaseKeywords.d: Legacy setting that formats VBScript keywords with uppercase spelling. Prefer aspLsp.format.vbscriptKeywordCase for new configurations.
configuration.format.alignAssignments.de: Align simple consecutive VBScript assignments into columns. Useful for short declaration blocks, but can increase diff noise in frequently edited code.
configuration.format.vbscriptBlockIndent: Controls indentation inside multiline <% ... %> VBScript blocks. alignWithDelimiter keeps statements level with the delimiters; indentInsideDelimiter indents statements one level inside them.
configuration.format.vbscriptTagIndentMo: Controls how embedded VBScript regions relate to surrounding HTML indentation. relativeToTag follows the parent tag, ignoreTag starts from column 0, preserveExisting keeps the region's current base indent, and null keeps legacy ignoreVbscriptTagIndent behavior.
configuration.format.cssTagIndentMode.de: Controls how embedded CSS blocks relate to surrounding HTML indentation. relativeToTag follows the parent style tag, ignoreTag starts from column 0, preserveExisting keeps the current base indent, and null keeps legacy ignoreCssTagIndent behavior.
configuration.format.javascriptTagIndent: Controls how embedded JavaScript and JScript blocks relate to surrounding HTML indentation. relativeToTag follows the parent script tag, ignoreTag starts from column 0, preserveExisting keeps the current base indent, and null keeps legacy ignoreJavaScriptTagIndent behavior.
configuration.format.aspDelimiterSpacing: Spacing inside ASP delimiters for one-line blocks, expressions, and directives. padded writes `<% code %>`; compact writes `<%code%>`.
configuration.format.aspBlockNewline.des: Controls line breaks for ASP blocks. preserve keeps the current conservative behavior, alwaysMultiline expands blocks, and singleLineWhenPossible keeps simple blocks on one line when safe.
configuration.format.nestedAspInCssJs.de: Controls embedded CSS/JavaScript regions that contain nested ASP tags. skipRegion leaves the mixed region untouched, protectAspOnly formats around protected ASP placeholders, and formatAroundAsp lets the delegate formatter see the original mixed content.
configuration.format.fragmentMode.descri: Controls how top-level Classic ASP markup is handed to the embedded HTML formatter. auto uses the normal HTML service behavior, fragment formats under a temporary wrapper and removes it afterward, and document formats the file as a complete HTML document.
configuration.format.ignoreVbscriptTagIn: Legacy setting that ignores parent tag indentation when formatting embedded VBScript regions. Prefer aspLsp.format.vbscriptTagIndentMode for new configurations.
Legacy setting that ignores parent tag indentation when formatting embedded CSS style elements. Prefer aspLsp.format.cssTagIndentMode for new configurations.
configuration.format.ignoreJavaScriptTag: Legacy setting that ignores parent tag indentation when formatting embedded JavaScript and JScript regions. Prefer aspLsp.format.javascriptTagIndentMode for new configurations.
configuration.format.onSave.description: Return full-document formatting edits from textDocument/willSaveWaitUntil so Classic ASP files can format during save. Disabled by default; VS Code format-on-save must also request save-time formatting.
configuration.vbscript.typeChecking.desc: Controls VBScript type diagnostics. Strict enables type mismatch, member, and call checks.
configuration.vbscript.identifierCase.de: Reports VBScript declaration names that do not match the selected identifier casing. Use ignore to disable naming hints.
configuration.vbscript.identifierCaseByK: Overrides VBScript identifier casing per declaration kind.
configuration.vbscript.comTypes.descript: Custom COM type catalog keyed by Prog.ID for Server.CreateObject type checking and completion.
Members exposed by this COM object.
configuration.vbscript.comTypes.memberSt: Property type shorthand, for example String, ADODB.Recordset, or String | Number.
configuration.vbscript.comTypes.type.des: Property or return type. Use | for union types.
configuration.vbscript.comTypes.returnTy: Method return type. Overrides type when present. Use | for union types.
configuration.vbscript.comTypes.paramete: Parameter type shorthand. Use | for union types.
configuration.vbscript.globals.descripti: Runtime or framework-provided VBScript globals keyed by identifier.
configuration.vbscript.globals.string.de: Global object type shorthand, for example MyCompany.Repository or String | Nothing.
configuration.vbscript.globals.type.desc: Global object type. Use | for union types.
configuration.vbscript.unusedDiagnostics: Report unused VBScript declarations as hint diagnostics.
configuration.vbscript.implicitGlobalDia: Report variables implicitly declared at script-global scope while Option Explicit is disabled as warning diagnostics.
configuration.vbscript.deadCodeDiagnosti: Report unreachable VBScript code as hint diagnostics.
configuration.vbscript.sqlSuggestOnSpace: Open SQL completion after typing a space that follows a SQL keyword inside a VBScript string literal.
configuration.vbscript.sqlInjectionDiagn: Report Request values concatenated into SQL strings at the selected severity. Values passed through a conversion, Replace, or a user function are treated as sanitized.
configuration.vbscript.syntaxSnippets.de: Enable VBScript syntax snippet completions for common control flow and declaration blocks.
configuration.vbscript.syntaxKeywords.de: Enable context-aware VBScript syntax keyword completions.
configuration.vbscript.autoIncludes.desc: Enable VBScript auto include completions and quick fixes for eligible workspace declarations.
configuration.vbscript.showUnresolvedSym: Include implicit global variables and unresolved Function/Sub call targets in VBScript completion lists. Disabled by default.
configuration.vbscript.assumeUndefinedGl: Treat otherwise undefined VBScript functions, variables, constants, and other identifiers as externally provided global symbols instead of reporting undefined-symbol errors. Disabled by default.
configuration.vbscript.initializedDimQui: Controls the quick fix style for initialized VBScript Dim declarations. newline rewrites to two statements on separate lines, and sameLineColon rewrites to Dim a : a = value.
configuration.vbscript.ifSyntaxDiagnosti: Controls how strictly VBScript If and ElseIf syntax is checked.
configuration.inlayHints.variableTypes.d: Show inferred VBScript variable type inlay hints.
Show VBScript procedure parameter name inlay hints.
configuration.inlayHints.functionReturnT: Show inferred VBScript function return type inlay hints.
configuration.inlayHints.implicitByRef.d: Show ByRef inlay hints for VBScript parameters whose passing mode is omitted.
configuration.inlayHints.scopeMarkers.gl: Show (global) before global VBScript variable type inlay hints.
configuration.inlayHints.scopeMarkers.lo: Show (local) before local VBScript variable type inlay hints.
configuration.inlayHints.scopeMarkers.un: Show (?) before type inlay hints for implicit global variables whose include/global context is uncertain.
configuration.codeLens.references.descri: Show VBScript reference count CodeLens entries.
configuration.codeLens.referenceProcedur: Show VBScript procedure reference count CodeLens entries for functions, subs, methods, and properties.
Show VBScript top-level variable and constant reference count CodeLens entries.
Show VBScript class reference count CodeLens entries.
configuration.codeLens.referenceClassMem: Show VBScript class field and class constant reference count CodeLens entries.
configuration.codeLens.includeRelatedInc: When the target include tree contains implicit global variables or unresolved references, also count usages from include parents, siblings, and ancestor descendant include trees. Enabled by default.
configuration.codeLens.includes.descript: Show Classic ASP include CodeLens entries.
configuration.rename.updateIncludesOnFil: Update Classic ASP include directives during file rename operations. Disabled by default; when disabled, file renames do not rewrite other files.
configuration.rename.workspaceSymbolRena: Allow symbol and selector rename operations to edit other Classic ASP workspace files. Disabled by default; same-file rename edits stay enabled.
configuration.styleExtraction.insertionM: Controls where inline style extraction code actions insert CSS rules. nearby creates a style element before the target tag, and reuseExistingStyleTag appends to the nearest existing style element when one exists.
Preferred Classic ASP flowchart node label line length before wrapping.
configuration.flowchart.labelMode.descri: Default Classic ASP flowchart label mode. Normal keeps the current labels, raw shows source-like statements, and description writes labels as prose.
configuration.flowchart.minZoom.descript: Minimum zoom factor available in Classic ASP flowchart webviews.
configuration.flowchart.maxZoom.descript: Maximum zoom factor available in Classic ASP flowchart webviews.
configuration.flowchart.infoPanelPositio: Controls whether the flowchart information pane appears on the left or right side.
Show the Classic ASP source code panel in flowchart webviews.
configuration.flowchart.openLocation.des: Controls whether flowcharts open in the active editor group or beside the current editor.
configuration.navigationGraph.openLocati: Controls whether navigation graphs open in the active editor group or beside the current editor.
configuration.workspaceFiles.openLocatio: Controls whether the workspace files view opens in the active editor group or beside the current editor.
configuration.webview.theme.description: Controls navigation graph, flowchart, and workspace file webview colors. Auto follows the current VS Code color theme.
configuration.excel.includeRelatedInclud: When Excel export runs, also analyze include parents, siblings, and descendant include trees to improve cross-file assignment and definition tables. Enabled by default.
configuration.excel.skipTypeInference.de: Skip editor-inferred VBScript type details during Excel export to make large workbooks faster. Disabled by default.
configuration.excel.locale.description: Language used for Excel export labels. auto follows the VS Code display language.
configuration.cache.enabled.description: Persist unopened workspace analysis results in the bbolt analysis database.
configuration.cache.directory.descriptio: Directory containing the Classic ASP LSP bbolt analysis database. Leave empty to use the OS temporary directory.
configuration.cache.freshness.descriptio: Controls how analysis database freshness is checked. auto uses metadata on local profiles and watch on network profiles, metadata verifies file metadata before reuse, and watch trusts file watcher changes to minimize network drive IO.
configuration.cache.ttlHours.description: Hours before bbolt analysis database entries expire.
configuration.cache.maxSizeMb.descriptio: Target bbolt analysis database size in megabytes. The database may exceed this target when active analysis data requires more space.
configuration.cache.gzip.description: Compresses bbolt analysis database records with gzip. Disabled by default to minimize restore CPU overhead.
configuration.memory.maxCacheBytes.descr: Maximum estimated in-process cache memory in bytes before asp-lsp evicts lower-priority caches. The default is 512 MiB.
configuration.memory.debugTelemetry.desc: Write memory budget snapshots and eviction details to the asp-lsp debug log file when debug log file output is enabled.
configuration.network.profile.descriptio: Filesystem performance profile. auto enables network-drive defaults for UNC paths and common SMB/NFS mount points; local keeps immediate filesystem checks; network enables TTL caches, higher include-read concurrency, watch freshness defaults, and fast case resolution.
configuration.network.statCacheTtlMs.des: Override stat/exists cache TTL in milliseconds. -1 uses the selected profile default, and 0 disables stat/exists caching.
Override directory-listing cache TTL in milliseconds. -1 uses the selected profile default, and 0 disables directory-listing caching.
configuration.network.includeReadConcurr: Override include traversal and include-reference read concurrency. 0 uses the logical CPU count.
configuration.network.caseResolution.des: Controls include path case resolution. auto uses the selected profile default; full checks directory entries for case mismatches; fast tries a direct stat first and may skip case-mismatch detection when the direct path exists.
configuration.workspace.includes.descrip: Workspace-relative glob patterns included in Classic ASP workspace analysis, workspace graphs, and folder graphs.
configuration.workspace.excludes.descrip: Workspace-relative glob patterns excluded from Classic ASP workspace analysis, workspace graphs, and folder graphs.
configuration.workspace.respectGitIgnore: Ignore files matched by a workspace root .gitignore during Classic ASP workspace analysis and graph folder scans.
configuration.workspace.scanChunkSize.de: Number of filesystem entries processed before yielding during workspace indexing.
configuration.workspace.busyAnalysisConc: Maximum workspace analysis concurrency. Set 0 to use the logical CPU count.
